page.layout: One printed page: heading "DEDICATORIA." at top, then running dedicatory text in full width, a centred two-line verse-like motto, a centred signature line. A partial column of text runs along the left edge of the scan (the facing page's margin, cut off), not transcribed as it is the neighbouring page's edge.

main_text.head: DEDICATORIA.

p.i: fiam, fidem, & integritatem, amorem & pietatem abunde est testata.

Sed facile sentio, quā tuis virtutibus non modo assentatorij stylifuco exaggerandis, sed vel sim-plici dictione commemorandis, nostra ieiuna oratio in pingues & nitentes oratorum campos nun-quam admissa impar fit. Ignosce quaso (generose Comes) insigni huic temeritati te tam audaciter appellare audæ & (quod vnum à te & petimus, & pro tua summa humanitate expectamus) hanc officiosam gratulationem, ab animo tuæ virtutis, quam sui commodi magis studioso profectam existima. Deus te ecclesiæ suæ tuaq; & patriæ et principi incolumem, veraque virtutis gloria floren-tissimum seruet. Londini anno salutis reue-latæ sesquimillesimo nonagesimo sexto, octauo ca-lendas Septembris.

main_text.p: Qui tuas virtutes omni amore & admiratione omni honore & gloria dignas judicat

page.notes: Partly illegible or doubtful words in the italic passage (e.g. "audæ", "tuaq;", "amplici") are as read from the scan. The left-edge fragments belong to the adjacent page and were omitted. The motto and signature are set in roman type, centred.
